description.en-US: Benson's account of 1914 of a pilgrimage to Lourdes: the town, the Grotto, the Bureau des Constatations, the apparition to Bernadette and the cures he witnessed.
description.pt-BR: O relato de Benson (1914) de uma peregrinação a Lourdes: a cidade, a Gruta, o Bureau des Constatations, a aparição a Bernadette e as curas a que assistiu.

sources.edition: Lourdes (London: Burns & Oates, 1914), Project Gutenberg #18729, proofread.
sources.description: Gutenberg licence and transcriber notes are dropped. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1914, so the text is public domain.
